_note: Hand-written extras for the cryptid guide pages, read by src/build_cryptid_guide_docs.py. Keyed by cryptid slug. Keys: intro_note, fixed_note (string or list of paragraphs, shown at the top of Fixed Spawn Locations), maps_expand, gallery [{file, caption, credit}], chance_maps (true = draw and show Chance to Spawn maps).

blue-devil.fixed_note: The Blue Devil has a fixed spawn at Naked Creek in Skyline Valley. When lightning hits the satellite dish at that camp, the game starts a Storm Encounter, and a Blue Devil spawns at one of two spots next to the dish.

mothman.fixed_note: Apart from the Point Pleasant ambush and the Scorched Mothman in the Enclave Research Facility, these are cultist encounter spots: only a Mothman can spawn there, but only at night (the game's IsTimeSpanAnyNight check), with a 5% chance each visit. During the Legend of the Mothman spotlight the chance rises to 35%, day or night.
